commands.command: TBD: build or audit a matched-current-response corpus where visible current response and scene are similar but prior command-response history or hidden dynamics imply different future envelope or action outcome
commands.name: m111_matched_current_response_ambiguity_audit

decision_rule: Before another hidden objective, prove the target surface is history-necessary by finding matched-current-response cases where current response is insufficient but history or hidden state can predict different capability or action outcomes.
failure_criteria: the corpus is merely hard but not matched on current response and scene
current-response-only baselines can solve the target as well as history
oracle hidden parameters are fed to the deployable actor
the next objective is trained before the ambiguity proof surface is defined
hypothesis: M110 failed because future-envelope prediction is mostly current-response Markov in the present task. Self-identification needs a proof surface with matched current observations but different history-dependent capabilities or action outcomes.
success_criteria: matched-current-response candidate rows are mined or shown absent
current-response-only and history/hidden features are compared on the matched surface
the result selects a corpus or explains why simulator/task construction must change
docs, queue, status, and scoreboard are updated
